# Sài Gòn chapter visual brief v0.1

**Thesis:** *Postcard from the city that kept giving.* Focus on the Landmark picnic (pink cap, blue-and-white checked blanket, white dog Gấu) rather than another image of a man at a monitor. The bridge and skyline are background context, not necessarily the main character.

## Art rules
- Geometric shapes, imperfect screen-print registration, rough ink grain, generous negative space and hand-written short accents.
- Keep the person’s privacy central. The supplied photographs are **private production references**, not approved public assets.
- Let Gấu and the gingham blanket act as visual continuity marks across all media.
- No copying the exact layout/lettering of the referenced Mac Ayres album artwork.
- No scenes not in the text, no corporate logo claims or fabricated family/relationship images.

## Palette and roles
| Name | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Overcast Pearl | `#D7DADC` | Cloudy Landmark sky, reflective pauses |
| Picnic Blue | `#6B91B5` | Gingham blanket, visual archive links |
| Grass Olive | `#668359` | Landmark lawn and hope/renewal |
| Sunset Peach | `#F7B58A` | Ba Son arrival, warmth and dusk |
| Dusty Pink | `#E9A7B4` | Cap and small affectionate details |
| Deep Ink | `#1D2A3A` | Black type, borders and late-stage reflection |
| Cream Paper | `#F6EBD7` | Reading pages and print stock |

## Poster delivery formats
- Master art without text, separately editable text, textures, and masks.
- A5 cropped art at printer-defined bleed and effective print resolution.
- Web hero 16:9 and mobile portrait with alt text.
- Instagram 1080×1440 (3:4), YouTube landscape 1280×720, short-form cover 1080×1920.
- Six to eight secondary spot illustrations illustrating the *source-confirmed* chapter stops.

## Narrative guardrail
Don't promise that the city or relationship solved the protagonist. He ends in Sài Gòn grateful and uncertain about what belonging means.
